results.title: Drip Drop
results.overview: A wealthy woman offers her best friend and husband $200,000 for a swingers weekend, unleashing chaos that threatens everyone's lives.

results.title: To Catch a Cheater
results.overview: When her teenage daughter dies under mysterious circumstances, a mother's search for truth unravels a chain of lies and betrayal among her closest friends, forcing her to confront evil in her own circle.

results.title: Voltei na Foto
results.overview: Leonardo is a man frustrated with his life until, unexpectedly, he is transported back to 1986. In the past, he encounters his younger self and attempts to change his own future.

results.title: In Bloom
results.overview: Circé is in love with Abel and lives with Vincent. But when she discovers she is pregnant, her illusions shatter: Abel isn't the man she hoped he would be, and she no longer loves Vincent. Faced with an impossible choice, she must decide whether to keep the baby or have an abortion.

results.title: My Awards
results.overview: At a film festival, a filmmaker tries to figure out what the jury is looking for in order to win the award. But the fear of failure threatens to ruin more than just his career, while the search for recognition throws his own desires into crisis.

results.title: Half Moon
results.overview: Riley and Lucy used to be close friends but have since grown apart over the years. While Lucy's long-term boyfriend is away at a bachelor party, she invites Riley to spend the weekend at her family's house upstate (now converted into an Airbnb), a trip they used to take together. Both live in New York, but haven't spent extended time together in years. Unspoken tensions surface as it becomes apparent how much distance there is between the two of them. Over the course of the weekend, they find small but unexpected ways to reconnect.

results.title: Wagner: Siegfried - Royal Ballet House
results.overview: Raised by a scheming dwarf and unaware of his true family origins, a young man embarks on an epic journey.

results.title: Heartman: Rock and Love
results.overview: Once known as the frontman of the rock band Ambulance during his college days, Seung-min now lives a quiet life running a small instrument shop. One day, his legendary first love Bo-na, the girl he never even had the courage to confess to before she suddenly disappeared, unexpectedly reappears in his life. From that moment on, Seung-min's heart begins to race again. But as old feelings resurface, he finds himself trapped in an awkward predicament: a secret he must never let his first love discover… no matter what.

results.title: Good Trip
results.overview: Shan, an art assistant, juggles responsibilities on the film set and at the hospital, where she cares for her father, Kueng, who has cancer. During her time at the hospital, Shan is tasked by the crew to collect a big bowl from the prop-studio. At her father's request, they discreetly leave the hospital together, embarking on an unexpected journey from the studio to Macau, and subsequently to Okinawa, allowing Kueng to address his unfulfilled wishes. Following his peaceful passing, Shan inherits not only memories but also a lasting sense of courage, optimism, and imaginative spirit that sustains her throughout life.

results.title: Godaan
results.overview: Godaan tells the story of Surbhi, an Indian cow who transforms a modern scientist’s beliefs. Her presence leads to discoveries in Panchgavya-based medicine, sustainable living, and the spiritual science behind cow reverence.

results.title: FKA twigs: Live at the Adidas Arena, Paris
results.original_title: FKA twigs: Live at the Adidas Arena, Paris
results.overview: As part of her "Body High" tour - FKA twigs brings her visionary spectacle to Paris for a genre-defying show. The performance served as a culmination of all that the artist has represented to culture over the last decade. It highlighted her mastery of WuShu, opera, visual arts, vogueing, pole-dancing, and her professional background in dance, while she performed songs from her GRAMMY-award-winning album 'EUSEXUA' and her lauded discography. A towering figure in modern music, FKA twigs is celebrated for her unique perspective and her total art approach – where sound, visuals, and performance merge into a single, immersive experience. The performance unfolds within a breathtaking scenography: video projections, theatrical vignettes, and choreography, all of which have earned praise from numerous publications, including The Guardian, which has described the tour as "an Olympian display of pop prowess.

results.title: Nooru Sami
results.overview: Selvi, a widowed mother, devotes her life to raising her two sons in a conservative village. Years later, unfulfilled life comes back into focus, challenging deep-rooted traditions. As family and society strongly oppose change, Selvi must choose between societal expectations and her own happiness.

results.title: Tell Me Everything
results.overview: Amid the late ’80s pop craze and rising HIV epidemic, 12-year-old Boaz uncovers a devastating secret about the father he idolizes that threatens to tear his family apart. Across a yearslong journey, Boaz seeks to heal the wound and reclaim the father-son bond he never stopped yearning for.

results.title: Game Over
results.overview: When Cleo and Jade’s date turns sour, they’re left questioning; ‘is the problem the male gaze or the way they’ve been conditioned to react?’ Game Over looks at how it feels to be a lesbian couple constantly sexualised and threatened by men.

results.title: Bullah
results.overview: After his father is murdered, a vigilante seeks revenge against those responsible.

results.title: Tomáš Töpfer: Mám se líp, než si zasloužím
results.original_title: Tomáš Töpfer: Mám se líp, než si zasloužím

results.title: Le souffle de vie
results.overview: In Polynesia, as humpback whales come to breed in the warm waters of the Pacific, Natoo immerses herself in a timeless experience.

results.title: Angel in the Rubble: The Genelle Guzman Story
results.original_title: Angel in the Rubble: The Genelle Guzman Story
results.overview: A Lifetime original recounting the true story of Genelle Guzman, the last survivor pulled alive from the World Trade Center ruins after 27 hours. The biographical drama chronicles her harrowing experience during the September 11 attacks and premieres on September 12, 2026, to mark the 25th anniversary of 9/11.

results.title: Solutus
results.overview: A struggling private investigator reluctantly takes on a missing-person case for a wealthy young client, only to find himself drawn into a conspiracy far more terrifying than he ever imagined.

results.title: Time to Go
results.overview: Patricio works for his sisters and feels trapped in a life that no longer fits him. Searching for change, he agrees to go on a date with a mysterious man.
